verdict.rationale: Channel3 publishes its own API reference, with per-endpoint pages such as api-reference/v1/search.md that document parameters. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser playground or runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on confirmation of the reference experience.
